crossRefs.note: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold…
Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.
Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays…
It was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
“Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

translations.web: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
translations.bsb: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.
translations.kjv: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
translations.asv: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, that went out to battle, and all the congregation.
